_comment: The expected image identity for scripts/g4_pipeline, declared outside the build output.
build.sh reads this file and fails (exit 75) when the image it built hashes to anything else.
It must never be read back from results/image_identity.txt, which build.sh writes: comparing a
value against the file the same run just produced is true by construction and detects nothing.
expected_image_id is the digest two independent clean builds of this Dockerfile agreed on,
adopted by the operator on 2026-10-02 (see the T4 proof in
docs/validation/2026-10-02-c1-pin-policy.md). It is deliberately NOT the 0f278c22 a drifted
rebuild produced, nor the 8e10185f the retired legacy builder produced. The pin contract forbids
silently replacing the expected digest; this was an explicit operator decision, not a build
artifact, and the 8e10185f value is kept below in blocking_reason as history.
What IS pinned mechanically and does reproduce: the base image digest, the apt snapshot and its
188 recorded package versions, and all 104 Python requirements with their sha256 hashes.
builder declares the build path the pin is measured on. As of C1 operator option (a)
(docs/validation/2026-09-30-g4-buildkit-reproducibility.md) the build path is `docker buildx` on
a BuildKit container builder under the declared memory ceiling, exporting with
rewrite-timestamp=true at the declared SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH. build.sh compares engine, plugin,
builder existence, driver, BuildKit version and ceiling against this declaration BEFORE building;
a host that cannot run the declared path exits 65. Probe measurements (2026-09-30, this branch)
show this path reproduces byte-identical image ids for clean builds of the declared step shapes;
the full pinned image HAS been proved reproducible post --no-compile fix (16adabe): two
independent clean builds produced b1b5270c49cffbd2165aed904226612f2ccf925072c91766b4d4979f24bb9296
with 11 of 11 layers identical, and the operator adopted it as expected_image_id on 2026-10-02.
cpuset_cpus is null because the buildx path bounds only memory (via --driver-opt): the legacy
`docker build --cpuset-cpus=0-3` CPU affinity is dropped there, and recording that as data rather
than prose keeps the omission explicit and reversible only by editing this field.
expected_image_id_source: Two independent clean builds of this Dockerfile from commit 16adabe, built as fin-g4-pipeline:r1 and :r2 on the declared g4repro buildx builder, 11 of 11 layers identical; operator adopted as the baseline on 2026-10-02. Proof record: T4 in docs/validation/2026-10-02-c1-pin-policy.md; per-layer digests in docs/validation/2026-10-02-c1-layer-diffids.txt.

builder.source: operator option (a), docs/validation/2026-09-30-g4-buildkit-reproducibility.md; engine per docs/validation/2026-09-29-324-c1-reproducible-pin.md Environment table
builder.note: The legacy builder named by the earlier declaration cannot reproduce a fixed digest and was retired by the operator's option (a) decision; this block pins the replacement path mechanically. Two clean buildx builds of this Dockerfile since the --no-compile fix did agree on one identity, so the block now also names the build path expected_image_id was measured on. It still does not claim the build reproduces unconditionally: the apt snapshot mirror is a live third-party dependency, so this is a reproducibility property of the declared inputs, not a guarantee about the mirror's uptime.

blocking_reason: Nothing blocks C1. The previous value sha256:8e10185fa27ea5adcfca94732adc27a2720ed9a31b67698d0a2c9e7a1a62c800 (L7, 2026-09-29) was produced by the retired legacy builder and is unreachable by any current builder: that path stamps a wall-clock created and per-build mtimes into the image, so no build-hygiene work can make buildx produce it. It is recorded here as history, not as a pending target. The current baseline is sha256:b1b5270c49cffbd2165aed904226612f2ccf925072c91766b4d4979f24bb9296, produced identically by two independent clean builds from commit 16adabe (fin-g4-pipeline:r1 and :r2, 11 of 11 layers identical) and adopted by the operator on 2026-10-02; see the T4 proof in docs/validation/2026-10-02-c1-pin-policy.md. The gate is unchanged by the adoption and still exits 75 on any other digest.
